arxiv-2012-13715.title: Structural, Elastic and Electronic Properties of SmFeO 3 using Density Functional Theory
arxiv-2012-13715.creator: Shahran Ahmed, Sadiq Shahriyar Nishat, Alamgir Kabir, A. K. M. Sarwar Hossain Faysal, Tarique Hasan, Shovon Chakraborty, Imtiaz Ahmed
arxiv-2012-13715.description: Abstract We perform first principles simulations for the structural, elastic and electronic properties of orthorhombic samarium orthoferrite SmFeO 3 within the framework of density functional theory. A number of different density functionals, such as local density approximation, generalized gradient approximation, Hubbard interaction modified functional, modified Becke-Johnson approximation and Heyd–Scuseria–Ernzerhof hybrid functional have been used to model the exact electron exchange-correlation.

arxiv-2102-10073.title: Pyserini: An Easy-to-Use Python Toolkit to Support Replicable IR Research with Sparse and Dense Representations
arxiv-2102-10073.creator: Jimmy Lin, Xueguang Ma, Sheng-Chieh Lin, Jheng-Hong Yang, Ronak Pradeep, and Rodrigo Nogueira
arxiv-2102-10073.description: Abstract . Pyserini is an easy-to-use Python toolkit that supports replicable IR research by providing effective first-stage retrieval in a multi-stage ranking architecture. Our toolkit is self-contained as a standard Python package and comes with queries, relevance judgments, pre-built indexes, and evaluation scripts for many commonly used IR test collections.

arxiv-2103-14292.title: Drag-based model (DBM) tools for forecast of coronal mass ejection arrival time and speed
arxiv-2103-14292.creator: Mateja Dumbović 1,∗ , Jaša Čalogović 1 , Karmen Martinić 1 , Bojan Vršnak 1 , Davor Sudar 1 , Manuela Temmer 2 , and Astrid Veronig 2,3
arxiv-2103-14292.description: Abstract 1 Forecasting the arrival time of coronal mass ejections (CMEs) and their associated shocks is one of the key aspects of space weather research. One of the commonly used models is, due to its simplicity and calculation speed, the analytical drag-based model (DBM) for heliospheric propagation of CMEs.

arxiv-2205-04902.title: Carrier Injection and Manipulation of Charge-Density Wave in Kagome Superconductor CsV 3 Sb 5
arxiv-2205-04902.creator: Kosuke Nakayama, 1,2,#,∗ Yongkai Li, 3,4,# Takemi Kato, 1 Min Liu, 3,4 Zhiwei Wang, 3,4,∗ Takashi Takahashi, 1,5,6 Yugui Yao, 3,4 and Takafumi Sato 1,5,6,
arxiv-2205-04902.description: Abstract Kagome metals A A V 3 Sb 5 ( A A = K, Rb, and Cs) exhibit a unique superconducting ground state coexisting with charge-density wave (CDW), whereas how these characteristics are affected by carrier doping remains unexplored because of the lack of an efficient carrier-doping method.

arxiv-2205-08087.creator: Ajoy Das, Gias Uddin, Guenther Ruhe
arxiv-2205-08087.description: Abstract . Blockchain is a distributed ledger technique that guarantees the traceability of transactions. Blockchain is adopted in multiple domains like finance (e.g., cryptocurrency), healthcare, security, and supply chain. In the open-source software (OSS) portal GitHub, we observe a growing adoption of Blockchain-based solutions.

arxiv-2307-10904.creator: Samuel J. Dunham, Eirik Endeve, Anthony Mezzacappa, John M. Blondin, Jesse Buffaloe, Kelly Holley-Bockelmann
arxiv-2307-10904.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Samuel J. Dunham, Eirik Endeve, Anthony Mezzacappa, John M. Blondin, Jesse Buffaloe, Kelly Holley-Bockelmann. We present numerical results from a parameter study of the standing accretion shock instability (SASI), investigating the impact of general relativity (GR) on the dynamics. Using GR hydrodynamics with GR gravity, and nonrelativistic (NR) hydrodynamics with Newtonian gravity, in an idealized model setting, we vary the initial radius of the shock and, by varying its mass and radius in concert, the proto-neutron star (PNS) compactness.

arxiv-2402-00073.title: The Effects of a Stably Stratified Region with radially varying Electrical Conductivity on the Formation of Zonal Winds on Gas Planets
arxiv-2402-00073.description: Abstract The outer areas of Jupiter and Saturn have multiple zonal winds, reaching the high latitudes, that penetrate deep into the planets’ interiors, as suggested by gravity measurements. These characteristics are replicable in numerical simulations by including both a shallow stably stratified layer, below a convecting envelope, and increasing electrical conductivity.

arxiv-2404-03405.title: Curves in the Fourier zeros of polytopal regions and the Pompeiu problem
arxiv-2404-03405.creator: Mihail N. Kolountzakis, Emmanuil Spyridakis
arxiv-2404-03405.description: Abstract . We prove that any finite union P P of interior-disjoint polytopes in ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} has the Pompeiu property, a result first proved by Williams [ Wil76 ] . This means that if a continuous function f f on ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} integrates to 0 on any congruent copy of P P then f f is identically 0.

arxiv-2404-04079.title: Self-Sensing Feedback Control of an Electrohydraulic Robotic Shoulder
arxiv-2404-04079.creator: Clemens C. Christoph, Amirhossein Kazemipour, Michel R. Vogt, Yu Zhang, Robert K. Katzschmann
arxiv-2404-04079.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Clemens C. Christoph, Amirhossein Kazemipour, Michel R. Vogt, Yu Zhang, Robert K. Katzschmann. The human shoulder, with its glenohumeral joint, tendons, ligaments, and muscles, allows for the execution of complex tasks with precision and efficiency. However, current robotic shoulder designs lack the compliance and compactness inherent in their biological counterparts. A major limitation of these designs is their reliance on external sensors like rotary encoders, which restrict mechanical joint design and introduce bulk to the system.

arxiv-2504-13580.title: Leveraging Automatic CAD Annotations for Supervised Learning in 3D Scene Understanding
arxiv-2504-13580.creator: Yuchen Rao *, Stefan Ainetter *, Sinisa Stekovic, Vincent Lepetit, Friedrich Fraundorfer, Project page: stefan-ainetter.github.io/SCANnotatepp
arxiv-2504-13580.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuchen Rao *, Stefan Ainetter *, Sinisa Stekovic, Vincent Lepetit, Friedrich Fraundorfer, Project page: stefan-ainetter.github.io/SCANnotatepp. † † ∗ The first two authors contributed equally to this work. High-level 3D scene understanding is essential in many applications. However, the challenges of generating accurate 3D annotations make development of deep learning models difficult. We turn to recent advancements in automatic retrieval of synthetic CAD models, and show that data generated by such methods can be used as high-quality ground truth for training supervised deep learning models.

arxiv-2505-02565.title: A Cross-Layer Analysis of Network Antifragility with RIS-assisted Links under Jamming Attacks
arxiv-2505-02565.creator: Mounir Bensalem, Thomas Röthig and Admela Jukan
arxiv-2505-02565.description: Abstract Antifragility is an economics term defined as measure of (monetary) benefits gained from the adverse events and variability of the markets. This paper integrates for the first time the antifragility into the network based on communication links with Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) affected by a jamming attack. We analyze whether antifragility can be achieved for several jamming models.

pmc-11490974.title: Factors Associated With a Successful Return to Performance After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Multiparametric Evaluation in Soccer Players
pmc-11490974.creator: Michele Mercurio, Simone Cerciello, Katia Corona, Germano Guerra, Roberto Simonetta, Filippo Familiari, Olimpio Galasso, Giorgio Gasparini
pmc-11490974.description: Background:Anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) is highly recommended in patients with ACL deficiency who must perform at a high physical level. A combination of functional and psychological outcome measures is necessary to provide a comprehensive evaluation of functional status after successful return to sport after ACLR.

pmc-11526077.title: Global research trends in the treatment of squamous cell carcinoma over the past decade: A bibliometric analysis
pmc-11526077.creator: Xueting Li, Alexander C Rokohl, Xiaojun Ju, Yongwei Guo, Xincen Hou, Wanlin Fan, Ludwig M Heindl
pmc-11526077.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to identify research trends and hot spots in the treatment of Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) over the past decade using bibliometric analysis.MethodsData were extracted from the Web of Science Core Collection, including Science Citation Index Expanded (SCI-Expanded), Social Sciences Citation Index (SSCI), and Emerging Sources Citation Index (ESCI).

pmc-12511195.title: Immunotherapy in the Treatment of Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma and Myxofibrosarcoma
pmc-12511195.creator: Jerry T Wu, Elizabeth Nowak, Jarrell Imamura, Jessica Leng, Dale Shepard, Shauna R Campbell, Jacob Scott, Lukas Nystrom, Nathan Mesko, Gary K Schwartz, Zachary D C Burke
pmc-12511195.description: Opinion StatementUndifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma (UPS) and myxofibrosarcoma (MFS) are among the most common adult soft tissue sarcoma (STS) subtypes. Due to their high genetic complexity, heterogeneity, and lack of specific genetic alterations, no consistent molecular targets for targeted therapy have been identified for UPS and MFS.

pmc-12646222.title: Electrokinetic nanoparticle transport in an interconnected porous environment: Decoupling cavity escape and directional bias
pmc-12646222.creator: Anni Shi, Siamak Mirfendereski, Ankur Gupta, Daniel K. Schwartz
pmc-12646222.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SignificanceWhile electrokinetic transport underlies bioengineering and separation technologies, the roles of electrophoresis (EP) and electroosmosis in complex porous environments remain poorly understood. Here, we report that these phenomena control the transport of charged nanoparticles via different pathways. While EP drives directional migration at high field strengths, it can cooperate with electroosmotic flow recirculation at weak fields to enhance transport efficiency by positioning particles near boundaries, facilitating rapid cavity escape without directional preference.

pmc-12823135.title: A mixed methods evaluation of 99DOTS digital adherence technology uptake among adolescents treated for pulmonary tuberculosis in Uganda
pmc-12823135.creator: P Wambi, SN West, J Nabugoomu, A Kityamuwesi, R Crowder, L Kunihira, E Wobudeya, A Cattamanchi, D Jaganath, A Katamba
pmc-12823135.description: Background:Adolescents are at risk of poor adherence to tuberculosis (TB) treatment and subsequently worse treatment outcomes. Digital adherence technologies, including the mobile phone-based 99DOTS platform, can support TB treatment, but there is limited data on their use among adolescents. We evaluated factors associated with uptake of 99DOTS among adolescents with TB.

pmc-13221332.title: Mapping the neural patterns of verbal repetition: an activation likelihood estimation meta-analysis
pmc-13221332.creator: Ariane Awana, Marcelo L. Berthier, María José Torres-Prioris, Diana López-Barroso
pmc-13221332.description: Verbal repetition involves transforming heard speech into articulatory motor output and constitutes a core language function integrating receptive and expressive processes within tight temporal constraints. This integrative nature underlies its importance for language acquisition and learning and accounts for its diagnostic relevance in acquired and developmental language disorders.

pmc-13312737.title: Multipronged management of chronic non-healing venous leg ulcers using advanced wound dressings and patient-centered care: a case report
pmc-13312737.creator: Dilip Kumar Kandar, Keshavi Killi, Debasis Chakrabarti
pmc-13312737.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundVenous leg ulcers are chronic wounds that can persist for years and severely affect quality of life, especially when complicated by infection and metabolic disturbances. This case is atypical, as it documents the complete healing of long-standing, bilateral venous leg ulcers that persisted for nearly a decade and became complicated by the onset of type 2 diabetes and Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection.

pmc-13517707.title: The Impact of Heavy Metals Exposure on Diabetic Foot Complications: A Systematic Review of Development, Progression, and Wound Healing
pmc-13517707.creator: Richard O. Machava, Bheki T. Magunga, Simiso M. Ntuli, Thokozani P. Mbonane
pmc-13517707.description: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) constitute a significant global health burden; however, the influence of environmental heavy metals toxicity on their pathogenesis remains insufficiently investigated, particularly within low- and middle-income countries. This systematic review, conducted in strict accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines, assesses the impact of heavy metals exposure on the development, progression, and wound-healing kinetics of DFUs.
